    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    valid_bins = bins > 0
    mask = valid_bins & (remaining >= 0)

    # Define a target range for optimal leftover space: [item * 0.1, item * 0.5]
    target_min = item * 0.1
    target_max = item * 0.5

    # Compute distance of current remaining space to the ideal target range
    dist_to_target = np.zeros_like(bins)
    dist_to_target[mask] = np.abs(remaining[mask] - (target_min + target_max) / 2)

    # Scale by the width of the target range to normalize the distance
    range_width = target_max - target_min
    range_width = np.where(range_width <= 0, 1, range_width)
    normalized_dist = dist_to_target / range_width

    # Prioritize bins closer to the center of the target range
    priority_scores = 1 - normalized_dist
    priority_scores = np.clip(priority_scores, 0, 1)

    # Apply penalty if remaining space is outside the target range
    out_of_range = (remaining < target_min) | (remaining > target_max)
    priority_scores[out_of_range] *= 0.5

    # Ensure invalid bins have zero priority
    result = np.zeros_like(bins)
    result[mask] = priority_scores[mask]
    return result
